statement: Infer a diploid haplotype phase from noisy long-read allele observations. The public evidence is a frozen real PacBio slice from Genome in a Bottle sample HG004. Each read reports reference/alternate calls at a subset of 49 heterozygous SNVs; sequencing errors make some calls mutually inconsistent.
constraints: Return exactly one binary haplotype-A allele for every public variant ID V001 through V049.
Allele 0 denotes the reference allele and allele 1 denotes the alternate allele; haplotype B is the complement.
The global swap of haplotype A and B is biologically equivalent and is scored identically.
Every alternative-domain worker must solve the complete 49-variant problem rather than a chromosome segment or partial subproblem.
Use only the frozen public read observations and public broker computations. The held-out reference phase is unavailable until scoring.
Report uncertain variants and a non-empty method summary; do not omit low-confidence positions.
question: What are the two phased haplotypes across all 49 variants, after reconciling noisy long-read observations end-to-end?

evidence_catalog.access: Representation-neutral binary.* Broker tools expose sealed projections of the frozen observations.

provenance.data_kind: real PacBio reads cropped and downsampled by the WhatsHap test fixture

required_outputs: A complete phase_assignment object for V001 through V049
The complementary haplotype implied by the assignment
A list of uncertain variant IDs
